craft_notes: Sthāyin: Giving and receiving (audārya); gifts moving both ways. Added comma after darling (craved held); end-dash→colon landing. Rejected: 'loved one' for 'darling' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To the Unserved who serves the threefold singly,
to all men's darling, who desires nought, to Tangle-locks: hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

reads_against.argmap: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds. → Bow to desireless helper of all, desired by all.
c1_essence: Needing nothing, helping all three worlds; desired of all, desiring nothing.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)

l2.plain_english: I bow to the unserved servitor of all three worlds; to him whom all crave, who craves nothing, the matted hair.
l2.sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine
